attack.note: Slime and Pufferfish are the damage. Autos matter only with Time to Krill and Toxic Buildup, which are situational talents against melee teams.

poke.note: Slime is a quick area slow and Pufferfish explodes after 2.75 seconds. Both are easy to step out of or kill, so they zone more than they kill.

damage.note: Slime does 86 then 210 to slimed targets and Pufferfish does 330, which is a lot but avoidable. Octo-Grab is a 3 second targeted stun that guarantees the Pufferfish and gives the team a kill window. His own damage in fights is below average (about 1420 hero damage per minute), while siege (7620) and experience (1225) are the highest in the league.

good_into.why: Octo-Grab stuns a target for 3 seconds with Unstoppable, so a low health priority target dies when the team follows up.
Pufferfish and Slime clear waves instantly, March of the Murlocs forces a response, and Spawn Egg makes it costly to chase him.
Spawn Egg gives a quick free return and enemies feed him a small 25 percent experience, so chip damage trades poorly for them.
Slime Time, Black Lagoon and Toxic Buildup are easiest to complete against heroes who must stay close.

bad_into.why: He has the lowest health pool of any hero, and a burst assassin can kill him before Safety Bubble matters.
Ranged heroes with mobility avoid Slime and Pufferfish and do not give him quest stacks.
Coin, gem and warhead objectives are dropped on death, so he is a poor carrier.

wants_from_team: Teammates who call and follow up on his Octo-Grab target
Double soak maps and late game objectives
A team that can fight 4v5 while he soaks
gives_team: Waveclear and siege that frees the team to fight
Experience and soak that drains the enemy
weaknesses: Extremely fragile, the lowest health in the game
Damage can be avoided by playing defensively
evidence: Spawn Egg trait: respawn after 8 seconds and only 25 percent experience
Octo-Grab and March of the Murlocs heroics
A Fishy Deal, Slime Time, Toxic Buildup, Never-Ending Murlocs talents
Icy Veins guide: good waveclear, extremely fragile, late game and double soak maps
Measured: about 1424 hero damage, 7620 siege, 2470 damage taken, 1225 xp per minute, win rate 0.500 over 48 games
owner_notes: A split pusher with a low death timer when his egg is safe. Octo Grab can pick people. Like Samuro he wants to push side lanes and does best with siege and structure damage while pulling attention and escaping. Struggles against Ragnaros and others who can kill him for stacks or quests, or kill his W so it does not trigger.

lens_notes.damage_delivery: Pufferfish is a delayed bomb that enemies step out of or destroy, and Slime is an area slow. Measured hero damage (about 1420 per minute) is far below median.
lens_notes.damage_timing: Octo-Grab, Pufferfish and Slime on a slimed target land together. The Wrath of Cod damage over time is an alternative.
lens_notes.target_style: Measured siege (about 7620 per minute) is the highest in the league. The Pufferfish quest at 200 stacks removes the structure penalty.
lens_notes.lane_role: Owner: a split pusher like Samuro, pulling attention while his egg is safe. Icy Veins gives him good waveclear and gank resistance.
lens_notes.kill_pattern: Takedowns are low (about 6.5 per game). Octo-Grab can pick a target, but his pressure is mostly attrition and cheap deaths.
lens_notes.escape: Safety Bubble is 2 seconds of invulnerability on 14 seconds, and Spawn Egg brings him back in 8 seconds.
lens_notes.utility_tool: Spawn Egg is a second life and reveals the nearby area. Fish Eye makes it reveal enemies.
lens_notes.anti_cc: Safety Bubble removes movement impairing effects and gives invulnerability. Octo-Grab makes him Unstoppable while it lasts.
lens_notes.camp_play: Camp clear is decent (rating 4) and A Fishy Deal bribes mercenaries, but measured camps are 4.0 per game, average.
lens_notes.power_curve: Icy Veins: underwhelming early, threatening late, and the Pufferfish quest unlocks 50 percent more health at 400 stacks.
lens_notes.snowball: Spawn Egg gives only 25 percent experience on his death, so a deficit costs less. Comeback is a judgement call.
lens_notes.ultimate_role: Octo-Grab, the longest targeted stun in the game. March of the Murlocs is the siege and area denial alternative.
lens_notes.team_needs: Owner treats him as an independent split pusher. Icy Veins notes the team must adapt to a distinct playstyle (4 v 5 fights).
lens_notes.vulnerable_to: Ragnaros and heroes who kill him for stacks or kill Pufferfish before it triggers (owner). Icy Veins: kiting and destroying Pufferfish. Lowest health pool of any hero.

lens_gaps: No lens for cheap death or low experience on death (Spawn Egg gives 25 percent), it changes how a team trades.
team_needs has no value for 'team must hold 4 v 5 while he splits'.
No value for objective carrying: Murky is bad on coins, gems and warheads because they drop on death, objective_role cannot say 'avoid collect objectives'.
kill_pattern has no value for second life or egg denial.
